title: Lymphocyte-to-C-reactive protein ratio as a clinically feasible nutrition-inflammation marker for predicting outcomes in patients with gastric cancer.
caption: (A) Forest plot presenting the combined hazard ratios for the association between baseline lymphocyte-to-C-reactive protein ratio and disease-free survival in gastric cancer. (B) Leave-one-out sensitivity evaluation demonstrating the robustness of this relationship. (C) Funnel plot assessing potential publication bias among the included studies. HR, hazard ratio; CI, confidence interval.
